correctness.rationale: For specified two-qubit XX Hamiltonian J>h>0, finite-temperature Gibbs state and local/collective amplitude-damping interpolation α, the symmetric and antisymmetric jump operators yield an invariant four-level pure-death population sector. Exact ODEs have antisymmetric decay γ(1-α), symmetric decay γ(1+α), and doubly excited decay 2γ. With ε=1-α and u=γεt in compact subsets of (0,∞), a(t)=p_beta exp(-u)+O(ε), while fast s,e populations vanish uniformly. Energy passivation of the remaining |a>,|gg> mixture gives Δ[1-2p_beta exp(-u)]_+; trace-norm Lipschitz bounds make convergence uniform. The singular limits differ Δ vs Δ[1-2p_beta]_+, and p_beta=1/2 gives unique beta_c satisfying sinh(2 beta_c J)=cosh(2 beta_c h). Solve for critical u_c and target work u_w. Independent 20 population/ergotropy examples and 12 direct full Lindblad 16x16 propagators confirmed the four-population dynamics; not a general all-ε certificate.
